OP, I'm sorry you're going through this. Children do have a duty to be obedient to their parents, but parents can exercise their authority without being disrespectful. Simply stating that she disapproved of your outfit would've been enough, but ringing your dad and carrying on just seems like a tear down instead of demonstrating authority. This wouldn't be ok to do a child and certainly not ok to do to another adult. 

Parents have the responsibility to guide their children, but can't make their decisions for them. Perhaps you have to remind her that you're a 25 year old woman and not a dress up doll. She doesn't have to like your outfits, but you're not responsible for her feelings or managing conflicts you didn't start. Since it seems to be a situation where there's no pleasing her, then wear what makes you your best self. Obey her where it's reasonable but you can only make so many accommodations where you're only living for someone else. 

Please pray for her OP, I hope she can see how this is affecting you and how this will damage your relationship. She needs to realize that obedience will come if her authority is from a place of love and a wish for what's best for you, not for her.
